payload.title: Import schema-valid files with classifier-specific templates and row errors
payload.description:
As an operator I want to supply representative examples in existing structured files without needing a transformer.
Feature: Structured example imports
  Scenario Outline: Validate a file
    Given a configured item schema and pinned classifier revisions
    When I preview an <format> file
    Then each row must include a schema-valid item and explicit labels and rationales for the selected classifiers
    And invalid rows show row numbers and field errors without importing anything
    Examples:
      | format |
      | Excel |
      | CSV |
      | JSON |
      | JSONL |
  Scenario: Download a template
    Given item fields and two classifiers
    When I request a template
    Then it contains the schema fields and independent label/rationale columns with configured label choices
  Scenario: Accept a batch
    Given a fully valid preview
    When I explicitly accept the batch
    Then items and human labels commit together exactly once
    And an invalid label, stale classifier, duplicate item or cancelled draft imports nothing
